sourceClass: Secondary Spanish transcription of declassified Russian wartime personnel-loss archive/Krivosheev commission
period: Great Patriotic War 1941–1945, original source's inclusion and force boundaries apply

commandStaffKilledMissingAllCauses.metricDescription: Command, officer and specialist categories: killed (including noncombat and on-ground causes), and missing
commandStaffKilledMissingAllCauses.warning: These are selected command/staff specialties, NOT necessarily every VVS serviceman or all flying personnel; missing does not mean proven dead. Source footnote includes deaths in air and on ground from all causes.

separatelyReportedCombatAviatorLosses.metricDescription: The source separately reports '27,600 combat losses' partitioned by type of air operations
separatelyReportedCombatAviatorLosses.warning: Cannot reconcile persons and service coverage to the 36,166 command-staff killed/missing table. 'Pilots' may be used loosely for multi-crew airmen. Do not add tables together.

dataQualityNotes: Do not infer killed-versus-missing for the separate 27,600 aviation-role statistic; the source does not split them.
The 36,166 category table is killed/missing from all causes, while 27,600 is combat-only, so their scopes are different.
No annual, unit, front, or aircraft-model detail is supplied by this source; such breakdowns must remain unknown.
Needs checking against the full Russian Krivosheev source for unit definitions and whether separate air forces are included.
